title: ChaosBench-Logic: A Benchmark for Logical and Symbolic Reasoning on Chaotic Dynamical Systems

bias_targets.methodology: Adversarial bias probes using template-based questions with misleading cues to test if models incorrectly conflate distinct scientific concepts (e.g., confusing deterministic chaos with randomness, nonlinearity, complexity, fractals, or PDEs).

Evaluating models using cross-system analogical and non-analogical reasoning tests to see if they overgeneralize system behavior based purely on surface-form names or shared structural cues (e.g., incorrectly assuming a system is chaotic simply because it is described as 'Lorenz-like').
